title: θ̂ 轴 seed:*:root 过滤（review-settlement knowledgeIds）
description: Split from YUK-1040 (code half). The FSRS subject pick in review-settlement.ts already strips `seed:<subj>:root` via SYNTHETIC_SUBJECT_ROOT_RE (YUK-1037), but the two `theta.knowledgeIds` call sites pass unfiltered ids to `updateThetaForAttempt` — a latent anchor-as-subject pollution for the 4 seed-root-bound questions. Apply the same regex filter to the theta axis, mirroring FSRS parity: mixed binding writes only real KCs; roots-only label set writes no knowledge-level mastery rows. Acceptance: solo+paper settle paths strip root ids before updateThetaForAttempt; DB test asserts mastery_state only for real KCs in a mixed binding and zero rows for a roots-only binding; non-root ids unchanged. See docs/triage/2026-09-25/sub-tickets.md §1a.

title: P3 — dreaming/maintenance charter 化（接 evidence-scout + objective 升章程）
description: Split from YUK-572 (the epic's only unlanded implementation slice). Bring `dreaming_nightly` and `knowledge_maintenance` (both already tool-loops) up to the charter-agent shape used by the meeting lane: attach the shared evidence-scout AgentDefinition (spawn-contract enforced, read-only, budget-shared), lift objective prompts into charter form, keep deterministic versions as fallback. Single-writer exit stays writeAiProposal/writeAgentNote. Guardrails: single-level spawn, run-level budget cap, settlement layer stays 0-agency. Spec: docs/design/2026-07-06-yuk572-agent-meeting-lane-spec.md (P3). Acceptance: both jobs can spawn the shared scout via the existing spawn contract; run-level budget accounts scout spend to parent; deterministic fallback preserved; spawn+agenda events recorded; scoped tests green. See docs/triage/2026-09-25/sub-tickets.md §2.
